title: NETWORK payload v1.0
description: One node or link measurement. occurredAt is the window end.

networkNodeId.description: Measured node or reporting endpoint for a link.

linkId.description: Measured link ID. Required only for NETWORK_LINK.

region.description: Synthetic region of the measured entity.

sampleWindowSeconds.description: Measurement window length in whole seconds.

status.description: Network state at the end of the window.

packetLossRatio.description: Lost probes divided by attempted probes.

latencyMs.description: Mean round-trip latency in milliseconds. Null when all probes fail.

throughputMbps.description: Average user-data rate in both directions, in decimal Mbps.

bytesTransferred.description: User-data bytes transferred in both directions. Excludes retries and overhead.

activeSubscriberCount.description: Subscribers served by this network element at window end.
